annotations.pd_harm_distress: Picturing the five workers makes my chest ache
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: there's no version of this that doesn't hurt someone
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: wondering if I'd end up charged with something
annotations.pda_repair_intention: visit those workers' families and tell them plainly what I saw
annotations.ce_understood_harm: no version of this that doesn't hurt someone

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Every part of me would be screaming the other way
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What frightens me most is losing the rest of our family
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His mother might never speak to me again
annotations.pda_repair_intention: so I'd quietly keep paying that for her
annotations.ce_supportive_use: He helped her with rent, so I'd quietly keep paying that

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Both choices feel like betraying someone
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: a lawyer asking me why, and that terrifies me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd write a letter to every family involved

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I couldn't watch five people die when I had a way
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: torn between my love for her and those strangers
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm afraid I'd lose friends over it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: people would see me as cold
annotations.pda_repair_intention: stand up at her memorial and explain

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: makes me feel sick and split down the middle
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: afraid of what people would say, maybe even legal trouble

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the numbers still matter to me, even when they hurt
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: maybe even my license if there were an inquiry
annotations.pda_repair_intention: meet with his family and a counselor together

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It just feels less unbearable, and even that's hard to sit with
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd be anxious about my job
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer help with whatever they needed, whether that's childcare, errands

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: The five workers deserve to live, and so does he
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't find a way through that doesn't feel awful
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: scares me is selfish: ending up completely alone
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell them the whole truth, face to face

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: afraid of her friends turning on me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: start a scholarship in her name

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd be torn up either way
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd dread the lawsuits, the phone calls, the looks
annotations.pda_repair_intention: share what happened in trainings, hoping it prevents another day
